description: Place a PAID order that preview_order priced, using its confirmation.confirmationCode. Charges the payment method saved in the user's ZapX account and creates a subscription that renews until cancelled. Requires confirm=true and userExplicitlyConfirmed=true. Only call this after showing the user confirmation.chargeSummary and getting their explicit yes to this exact order; never on your own initiative. The code orders exactly the previewed configuration; to change anything, run preview_order again. Refused when the price changed since the preview, without a saved payment method, or above the daily limit of orders through the MCP. Retrying with the same code never orders twice. If the bank asks for a confirmation (3-D Secure), the result contains paymentActionUrl for the user.

confirm.description: Must be true. Same confirm=true every state-changing MCP tool requires; set it only together with userExplicitlyConfirmed=true.

confirmationCode.description: confirmation.confirmationCode from preview_order. It stands for exactly the previewed order; nothing else can be ordered with it.

requestImmediateStart.description: true only if the user also expressly agreed to confirmation.immediateStartNotice (start right away, compensation for used days on withdrawal). Required for most paid orders; without it the order is refused with WITHDRAWAL_EARLY_START_REQUIRED.

userExplicitlyConfirmed.description: true only after the user explicitly agreed to this order and its price in the conversation (e.g. replied "yes" to the shown confirmation.chargeSummary).

name: create_order
title: Place Paid Order
